a.lede: Lenders don't want SpaceX shooting their collateral into orbit. What does that mean for space data centers writ large?
a.title: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?

b.lede: The $43 billion loan is structured as a unique arrangement in which a different company buys the Nvidia chips, while SpaceX makes quarterly payments to use them.
b.title: Lenders back SpaceX's $43 billion Nvidia GPU deal but worry the collateral could end up in orbit, making them impossible to reclaim if Musk defaults
